summary_1line: Rama asks about Hanuman’s unmatched prowess; a sage recounts Hanuman’s birth and childhood feat of leaping to seize the sun, provoking gods and Indra’s thunderbolt.

image_candidates.scene_text: The child Hanuman leaps into the sky toward the rising red sun, mistaking it for a ripe fruit while the wind-god follows protectively.
Indra atop the white elephant Airavata hurls a thunderbolt that strikes the airborne child Hanuman.
Vayu cradles the unconscious Hanuman inside a cave as the world outside suffocates without wind.
